evidence.required_key_refusal: adapt_v2.py requires schema, task_id, sources, turns, checkpoints, acceptance, answer_budget (+ acceptance.checks_structured, acceptance.negative_constraints, answer_budget.system_prompt_addition) and exits 1 naming the fixture and missing key

assumptions: adapt_fixture.py is importable as a plain module (sys.path.insert of the longrun dir); it has stdlib-only top-level imports — tiktoken is imported lazily inside measure_bytes_per_token, so no reimplementation was needed for the pinned-source loading, pointer slicing, digest verification, bytes-per-token measurement or the instruction->question mapping
N is carried as len(turns), with long_run.turns asserted equal; a mismatch refuses rather than picking one
wall_tokens is not stated by the v2 fixtures, so adapt_fixture.DEFAULT_WALL_TOKENS (65536) is used, same default and same recorded flag as the v1 tier
derived_from.path is recorded relative to the longrun dir (not os.path.abspath) so the runtime bytes do not depend on the caller's cwd — this is the one deliberate divergence from adapt_fixture.py

score_longrun.py cannot emit a scorecard for a zero-byte log (it is an input error, exit 3), so the card's 'verified_success: false + unverifiable count' was measured on a log of two answer-less rows, both with and without a run-start fixture_sha256 header
